S: Twice fried chips under thick beef gravy
Thick chips cooked twice until crisp, piled into bowls, scattered with torn mozzarella and covered in hot beef gravy so the cheese melts.
Medjool dates wrapped in bacon and baked
Medjool dates wrapped in half rashers of bacon, held with toothpicks and baked at 200C for 15 minutes until crisp and sticky.
M: The Hudsons' farmhouse pancakes, bacon and eggs
Buttermilk pancakes with crisp bacon and fried eggs on one plate
Buttermilk pancakes, fried eggs and crisp bacon on one big plate, drowned in maple syrup, the full farmhouse breakfast.
Fred Dukes garlic butter rib eye

Rib eye seared hard and butter basted with garlic, rested and served with crispy roast potatoes and greens. Take 4 rib eye steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes early and season well. Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, then add 60g butter, 3 crushed garlic cloves and rosemary and baste for 1 minute. Rest 5 minutes. Sauté 2 bunches broccolini in the pan butter. Serve the steak sliced with potatoes, greens and the pan juices.
W: Maple syrup, egg and cream custard in a shortcrust case
Maple syrup whisked with eggs and cream, poured into a blind-baked shortcrust shell, baked at 170C for 40 minutes until just set.
the Canadian forest where Logan lives with Kayla

Pecans tossed in maple syrup, brown sugar, chilli and sea salt, roasted until glassy and crunchy, broken into sweet and salty clusters. Toss 300g pecans with 60ml maple syrup, 1 tbsp brown sugar, half a teaspoon chilli flakes, a pinch of cinnamon and 1 tsp sea salt. Spread on a tray lined with baking paper and roast at 170C for 12 minutes, stirring halfway, until the syrup bubbles and darkens. Sprinkle with a little more salt and leave to cool for 15 minutes so the coating sets crunchy, then break into clusters.
K: Whisky, lemon and maple, for drinking to remember

Canadian whisky shaken hard with lemon juice, maple syrup and egg white until silky and foamy, served over ice with a few drops of bitters. Make 2 drinks at a time. Add 120ml Canadian whisky, 60ml lemon juice, 40ml maple syrup and 1 egg white to a shaker without ice and shake hard for 15 seconds. Add a big handful of ice and shake again until very cold. Strain into 2 rocks glasses over fresh ice and add 3 drops of bitters to the foam. Repeat for the other 2. For non-drinkers, use cold black tea instead of whisky.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the gravy up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and reheat; fry the chips fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips and dry well.
Fry the chips once in the oil at a lower heat until soft.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and simmer until thick.
Fry the chips again in the oil at high heat until crisp.
Pile into bowls, scatter with torn mozzarella and pour over the hot gravy.

dishes.make_ahead: Wrap the dates in bacon up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; bake just before serving

steps.text: Halve the bacon rashers and pit the dates.
Wrap bacon around each date and secure with a toothpick.
Bake at 200C on a lined tray, turning once, until the bacon is crisp.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the eggplant strips and wrap the dates up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; bake just before serving

steps.text: Slice the eggplant lengthwise into 8 thin slices and halve each. Brush with the oil, soy sauce, paprika and maple syrup.
Cook the strips in a hot pan for about a minute each side until just soft. Pit the dates.
Wrap a strip around each date and secure with a toothpick.
Bake at 200C on a lined tray, turning once, until the edges are crisp.

af.make_ahead: Tea up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and chill until cold.
Shake 240ml of the tea with the lemon juice, maple syrup and egg whites without ice for 15 seconds, two drinks at a time.
Add ice and shake again until very cold.
Strain over fresh ice into rocks glasses and grate a little nutmeg over the foam.

s.note: Twice fried chips under thick beef gravy

s.note: Medjool dates wrapped in bacon and baked
s.how: Cut 8 rashers of bacon in half. Wrap each half around a pitted medjool date and secure with a toothpick. Lay on a lined tray and bake at 200C for 15 minutes, turning once, until the bacon is crisp and the dates are sticky.

m.n: The Hudsons' farmhouse pancakes, bacon and eggs
m.note: Buttermilk pancakes with crisp bacon and fried eggs on one plate
m.how: Whisk 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs and 375ml buttermilk into a batter and cook pancakes in butter. Fry 8 rashers of bacon and 4 eggs. Pile it all on one big plate and drown it in maple syrup.

w.note: Maple syrup, egg and cream custard in a shortcrust case
w.how: Blind bake a shortcrust case. Whisk 250ml maple syrup with 3 eggs and 200ml cream until smooth. Pour into the case and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Cool completely before slicing.
